author: Kushal
problem: Read N and two sequences A and B of N integers (the values within each sequence are distinct). Print two lines: the number of positions i with A_i = B_i, and the number of pairs of different positions i and j with A_i = B_j.
bug_description: The second count does not require i != j, so matches at the same position are counted again.

comments.accurate: Prints the count of same-position matches, then the count of matches at different positions
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the count of same-position matches, then the count of all value matches between A and B
comments.wrong_location: Pair-count loop verified; check that the first loop compares A and B at the same index
